drivers: one library consumed in-process through a fixed Python interface
strong consistency between accounts, identities, sessions and roles
no independent scaling or release need

alternatives.reason: an identity service plus a roles service would add network calls and distributed consistency for a few hundred lines of logic
sign-in and role checks are synchronous; nothing is naturally asynchronous
a real OAuth provider is an external service, handled by an adapter boundary rather than a separate service

style.reason: Simplest design that meets every driver: one package, two modules with a one-way dependency

stack.backend: Python 3.8+ standard library (hashlib, hmac, secrets, threading, time, uuid)
stack.database: in-memory store inside the app object (same as all three sources); persistence is out of scope

reasons.backend: D01: task.md requires standard library only and a Python interface; all sources are Python
reasons.database: D02: the sources keep data in memory and the interface has no storage parameter; a storage adapter can come later
reasons.frontend: D03: the request is an identity module, not screens
reasons.tests: D04: unittest needs no installs (installs are not approved)

modules.name: roles
modules.responsibility: the unified role set, permissions, the one can(role, permission) check, role ranks and the source-role mapping

modules.name: identity
modules.responsibility: users, password credentials, federated identities with verified-email linking, sessions, and admin-only role changes through the session's caller

entities.name: User
entities.notes: one account per person; role from role_mapping at creation

auth.method: password (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, per-credential salt and iteration count) and federated OAuth (provider callback data); one identity system
auth.session: opaque random token (token_urlsafe(32)) stored as SHA-256, expiry 8 h by default, revoked by logout

slices.name: Admin-only role changes and first-admin bootstrap

decisions.decision: In-memory store owned by the app object created by create_app()
decisions.reason: matches the sources and the required interface; persistence not requested

decisions.decision: No UI or HTTP layer; the Python interface in task.md is the API
decisions.reason: the hidden tests use that interface

decisions.decision: Modular monolith: roles module and identity module, identity depends on roles
Federated sign-in joins an existing account only when email_verified is exactly True and the normalised email is owned by an existing account; otherwise a separate account
Role mapping A:user->editor, B:member->viewer, C unchanged; only admins change roles; nobody raises their own role
Duplicate password registration refused (AuthError), never overwrites
decisions.reason: A's overwrite is an account takeover
A's callers caught ValueError; keeps them working

decisions.decision: set_role with an invalid session raises PermissionError (the caller is not an admin); unknown role ValueError; unknown target KeyError
decisions.reason: task.md: PermissionError unless the caller is admin

decisions.decision: bootstrap_admin works only while no admin exists
decisions.reason: setup only; otherwise it would bypass the admin-only rule
